checks.notes: The public builder copies internal review and operational source records into the deployable Site tree.

findings.expected: The public deploy tree contains only an explicit allowlist of reader-facing case details and validated downloads, with internal review, source notes, and operational source fields absent.
findings.observed: Generated public case routes expose review.json, source.json, and source-notes.md, including reviewer, artifact, request, and source-inspection details that are outside the approved public projection.
findings.summary: The deployable public Site includes internal review and operational source records.

findings.expected: A fresh #method route remains aligned with the Method section after public catalog rendering completes at every approved width.
findings.observed: A fresh #method load initially scrolls to Method, then the catalog expansion above it moves the section outside the viewport on wide and tablet screens.
findings.summary: The direct Method route loses its target after the asynchronous catalog settles.

results.notes: The opening now defines design in plain language, names familiar examples, and gives a non-designer a useful first action.
The opening now combines the explanation, a useful starting path, and an actual case-study composition within the first planned wide and mobile viewports.
The repaired system uses the approved grid, contextual layers, evidence hierarchy, and comparison relationships without source-brand mimicry.
The catalog now begins with 12 cases and reveals 12 more per action while preserving search, filters, comparison state, focus, and access to all 60.
Case detail now leads with the problem, why it matters as an explicit interpretation, what to notice, what to try, and caution before technical detail.
Every case now receives an original explanatory UI composition derived only from approved public fields and labeled as interpretation.
The package view now explains Markdown for people and JSON for tools before exposing exact bytes, media types, and hashes.
The repaired copy uses a direct teaching voice and explains specialist terms where they appear without inventing personal testimony.
The deterministic renderer now consumes approved layout, pattern, motion, platform, character, journey, density, relationship, and token fields and produces 60 unique signatures.
